name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2005 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2005 record supports: the FTC's complaints and releases on CardSystems (SQL injection, collection and scheduled exfiltration of card data), BJ's and DSW (default credentials and open wireless), the LexisNexis/Seisint filings on misused customer credentials, the Justice Department's Gonzalez charges (wardriving and sniffers), Microsoft's MS05-039 and Advisory 899588, CERT/CC's VU#998653 and the FBI's arrests for Zotob, US-CERT's TA05-180A on the VERITAS Remote Agent, TA05-189A on targeted trojan e-mail and TA05-362A on the Windows Metafile flaw, CERT/CC's VU#312073 on Sony BMG's XCP rootkit, and the Justice Department releases on Ancheta's botnets, the Massachusetts juvenile, the RPCSDBOT juvenile, Jiang and Lyttle, with the Samy worm from its author's account graded Reported. No 2005 source prints an ATT&CK id: every entry is this study's later mapping. Equation's four group techniques are not in this layer. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2005.md. Scores: 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports the behavior, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
